item.title: FBI Arrests Executive at Ransomware Negotiation Firm
item.dc:creator: BrianKrebs
item.content:encoded:
Agents with the Federal Bureau of Investigation on Thursday arrested an executive at a Canadian cybersecurity firm in connection with an investigation into the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently relieved the FBI of sensitive data on thousands of agents, multiple sources tell KrebsOnSecurity.

Federal court records show the defendant faces cyber extortion and conspiracy charges.

item.title: ShinyHunters Extorted Boeing Spin-off Prior to Arrests
item.dc:creator: BrianKrebs
item.content:encoded: A teenager from Amman, Jordan suspected of leading the prolific data theft and extortion group ShinyHunters has been detained and is reportedly cooperating with the FBI to identify other members of the hacking gang.
